question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **beguilling**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling and meaning of the selected option are as follows: 
 
 
• **Beguiling:** charming or enchanting. (आकर्षक)
 
 
 
• Thus, the incorrectly spelt word is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Irritating: **to make somebody angry; to annoy. (किसी को क्रुद्घ करना; नाराज़ करना)
 
• **Pedestrian: **a person who is walking in the street (not travelling in a vehicle). (पैदल यात्री)
 
• **Enervating: **causing one to feel drained of energy or vitality. (शक्तिहीन करना)
